summary: Dots Studio's Dots3-Note Preview is served free through OpenRouter as dots-studio/dots-3-note-preview:free at $0 prompt / $0 completion with a 512K context window. Open-weight MoE (16B active / 280B total); text+image input, text output; tools, structured outputs, and reasoning parameters are listed. Hosted by AtlasCloud. Listed in the Models API since 2026-08-14 with no published end date. Standard OpenRouter :free rate limits apply (see openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits). Distinct from paid Dots 3 family endpoints.
claim_steps: Sign up at openrouter.ai and create an API key (OpenRouter :free models do not require purchasing credits).
Call the chat completions API with model id dots-studio/dots-3-note-preview:free.
